history.value: The product stays the 10-29 net after lane crossed-player: the SharpHide-then-stage-B burst net two turns deep on the product's decks gains +1.08 (0.47) end-HP and no clears (-0.006 (0.014)), with the protocol's test open at its 500 cap on one book and matched decks, so it is a lead (measurement/crossed-player@two-turn, decision/headline-unit, yardstick/protocol). No confirm read on sequences 500-999: a pass would swap the fighter for about +1 HP and no clears and owe a new headline control, a fail changes nothing. A fighter-only change earns a two-turn promotion read when it lowers boss deaths two turns deep, or when run choices exist that turn HP after the second elite into clears; a one-turn gain at the bosses does not, because depth takes it (cause/leaf-gain-third). A second training seed of that burst above +1.0 HP one turn deep would show a one-turn recipe, not a product change. The burst lottery (many burst seeds, keep the best) stays closed: the best of 20 further draws is worth about 0.2 HP two turns deep.
